scoring_justification: The verifier cannot re-run DFT; comparison of agent's reported values against paper-derived gold with tolerances is the feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold reference values for bond lengths, magnetic moments, energy ordering, and coupling sign
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper-reported DFT+U results: Fe-O bond length ≈1.92 Å, Co-O ≈1.74 Å; Fe magnetic moments high-spin ≈4.4 μB (antiparallel to Co), intermediate-spin ≈2.9 μB (antiparallel); high-spin state is ground state; coupling is antiferromagnetic.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper's computational results section and corroborated by the reference DFT+U output.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values directly correspond to the paper's published computational data and are used with tolerances that accommodate toolchain variations when re-run with different DFT codes.

outputs.description: DFT+U results: total energies, spin magnetic moments, bond lengths, and the sign of Fe-Co magnetic coupling. The numerical values will be compared against reference values from the paper using tolerances; the coupling_sign must be 'antiferromagnetic'.

output_contract.notes: The quantities are compared to the paper-reported values (Fe-O ≈1.92 Å, Co-O ≈1.74 Å, Fe moments ≈4.4 μB high-spin, ≈2.9 μB intermediate-spin, high-spin ground state, antiferromagnetic coupling). No gold values are disclosed in the public contract.
